title: Addition Facts
subtitle: Sums within 10, up to 100
bounds: Facts bounds (PROTOCOL 4c): one prompt 'a + b = ?', answer s = a + b. Sum bands by tier: T1 2-10 (a, b >= 1), T2 11-20, T3 21-40, T4 41-70, T5 71-100 (a, b >= 2 from T2 on; T2 min(a, b) <= 9 and >= half are one digit + one digit crossing ten). T3-T5: >= half regroup (ones make a ten), >= a quarter two-digit + one-digit, <= a quarter with a multiple of 10 as an operand. Wrong choices: distinct non-negative integers <= 999, >= 2 near the answer (+-1, +-2, +-10), at most 1 far; answer rank among the 4 values 15-35% each per tier; T3-T5 every item has a wrong choice sharing the answer's ones digit.

tiers.name: Within 10
tiers.description: Sums up to 10: counting on, doubles and pairs that make ten.

tiers.name: Within 20
tiers.description: Sums from 11 to 20: doubles, near doubles and make-a-ten.

tiers.name: Within 40
tiers.description: Sums from 21 to 40: add the tens, then the ones.

tiers.name: Within 70
tiers.description: Sums from 41 to 70: regroup when the ones make a ten.

tiers.name: Within 100
tiers.description: Sums from 71 to 100: tens first, then ones, then put together.

ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Count again: start at the bigger number and count up.
ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted on wrong: the sum is one more or one less than the true sum.

SUBTRACTED.student: Plus means put together. Add the two numbers, don't take them apart.
SUBTRACTED.teacher: Subtracted the smaller addend from the larger instead of adding: 8 + 5 = 3.

NO_CARRY.student: The ones made a new ten. Add that ten in with the tens.
NO_CARRY.teacher: Dropped the regrouped ten when the ones summed to 10 or more: 38 + 47 = 75.

TENS_SLIP.student: Check the tens place. Add the tens, then the ones.
TENS_SLIP.teacher: Tens digit of the sum is one too many or too few, with the ones right: 34 + 52 = 76 or 96.
